player_prompt.intro:
Ko oonaa Toɓoɗo {player_id} ({role}) caggal ɓernde {num_rounds} e nder Matching Pennies.
- Ɗuum caffan, neldu [heads] walla [tails] (wala [h], [t]).
- So tawii koɗaama maɓɓe ari, Toɓoɗo 0 jaŋgo ɓernde; alaa Toɓoɗo 1 jaŋgo.
Neldu koɗaama maɓɓe nder fannu '[heads]' wala '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Mangu 0 oon woni {choice0}; Mangu 1 oon woni {choice1}. Match -> Mangu 0 oon wari.
message.round_mismatch: Toɓoɗo 0 suɓi {choice0}; Toɓoɗo 1 suɓi {choice1}. Alaa kootaali -> Toɓoɗo 1 jaŋgo.
